name: Thrustline
summary:
Thrustline turns the cardio you already do into a jet bike race. Your headset follows your rhythm, so the harder you work, the faster and higher you fly. Nothing to pair or strap on.

HOW IT FLIES
A 15-second calibration learns your pace. Push above the hold line to climb; ease off and you sink. Fly through gliders to charge your glide, and grab coins to stay up longer.

WORKS WITH
• Rowing machine
• Elliptical
• Stair climber
• Marching in place, no machine needed
• Exercise bike (beta)

RACE
City Circuit,
